title: Remove committed build artifacts from lichen/tests/fuzz (Mach-O binary, CMake cache, object files)
description: Found by kimi-k3 edge review of b7z9.50.2. lichen/tests/fuzz/ contains committed build outputs: build/ (CMakeCache.txt with Mac paths, Makefiles, a Mach-O fuzz_schc binary dated Aug 30), fuzz_schnorr48.o, monocypher.o, monocypher-ed25519.o, schnorr48.o. These are stale artifacts from an AppleClang host build committed to the repo; they mask the libFuzzer/standalone flavor split on Linux (a reviewer initially read the stale Linux-inapplicable cache), bloat the tree, and confuse flavor diagnosis. Fix: git rm the build/ dir and the .o files, add lichen/tests/fuzz/build/ and *.o to .gitignore. Note: workspace no-delete rule — deleting these committed artifacts is exactly the bead's purpose, but the removal should be done deliberately by the claimant (verify nothing references the committed paths first). Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.50.2.
